name: fast-pdf-reader
description: Read local PDFs with smooth continuous scrolling, crisp cached pages, early text selection and contextual change requests in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Smooth local PDF reading and contextual comments
interface.longDescription: A local desktop PDF reader with continuous scrolling, crisp cached page images, independent text selection, search, bookmarks and a compact single-row toolbar. Select a passage or figure to compose a contextual change request in supported Codex hosts. PDF rendering runs locally; comments and selected content enter the host only when you explicitly add a request. Requires Node.js 22.13 or newer and a compatible desktop host. Windows is the validated platform.
defaultPrompt: Open Fast PDF Reader so I can read a local PDF.
